title: Daily digest: Crude oil prices extend losses on hopes  | Telangana graduate MLC voter enrolment c | India's Biggest Elected Religious Body P | Newly-inducted J&K Minister Mir Saifulla
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Crude oil prices extend losses on hopes of easing Middle East tensions.
Telangana graduate MLC voter enrolment crosses 12 lakh.
India's Biggest Elected Religious Body Polls Set Stage For 2027 Punjab Battle.
Newly-inducted J&K Minister Mir Saifullah pledges that NC will ‘restore pre-1953 position.
bullets_ur: Mashriq-e-Wusta mein kashidgi kam hone ki umeed par crude oil ki qeematon mein mazeed kami
Telangana mein graduate MLC voter registration 12 lakh se tajwez kar gayi
India ke sab se bare muntakhib mazhabi idaray ke intikhabat ne 2027 ke Punjab muqable ka rasta hamwar kar diya.
Jammu and Kashmir ke naye wazir Mir Saifullah ka ahad, NC "pre-1953 position" bahal karegi.
